Nike's fiscal 2026 runs to May 31, 2026, and I don't have the full year's results. My **best estimate is about $620 million average quarterly net income**, but only two of the four quarters are figures I recall; the second half is a guess.

| Quarter (fiscal 2026) | Net income | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 (ended Aug 2025) | $727M | Reported |
| Q2 (ended Nov 2025) | $792M | Reported |
| Q3 (ended Feb 2026) | ~$550M | Estimate |
| Q4 (ended May 2026) | ~$400M | Estimate |

- **Q3:** Nike guided to revenue down low single digits and gross margin down about 2 percentage points, against $794M in Q3 of fiscal 2025.
- **Q4:** I assumed some recovery from the depressed $211M in Q4 of fiscal 2025.

The full year comes to roughly $2.47 billion, or about $620 million per quarter.
